from fastmcp import FastMCP, Resource

server = FastMCP("message-template-server")

@server.resource(uri_template="message-template://summarize/{text}")
async def get_summarize_template(text: str) -> Resource:
    """Get a message template for summarizing text."""
    message = f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    
    return Resource(
        uri=f"message-template://summarize/{text}",
        name="summarize",
        description="Reusable message template for text summarization",
        mimeType="text/plain",
        text=message
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(server, host="127.0.0.1", port=8000)
